multi_entity_note: single patient case report; no distinct parties in different roles

medical.diagnosis.rationale: Clinicopathologic presentation supported a diagnosis of ILVEN (inflammatory linear verrucous epidermal nevus) over the listed differentials.

medical.treatment_drug.rationale: After diagnosis, ILK (intralesional triamcinolone acetonide) was the treatment given; the topical agents were earlier unsuccessful treatments and tofacitinib was added later and stopped.
